summary: The UserHistory module tracks and manages changes to user-related actions, including authorization events, role changes, and comments. It enables searching for user history and recording updates when user actions occur.
purpose: To record and retrieve historical actions performed by or on users, including details of authorization, reasons, associated comments, relevant dates, and roles. Provides mechanisms to add and search user history records.

workflows.name: GetByUser
steps: Execute query and read resulting user history data
Populate UserHistory fields and format dates/names

workflows.name: AddChanged
steps: Receive inputs: session, user ID, authorized date, authorized by, reason code, comment, viewOnly, hideStudentNames, roleID, disabled, authorizedByContactID

business_rules: Actions recorded must include the authorized person and reason code.
ActionDate and AuthorizedBy information are mandatory for history records.
Role changes, visibility changes, and disabled status are tracked if provided.
validations: ReasonCodeID and AuthorizedByContactID are validated (default value 0 used if not provided).
calculations: NameFormatted and AuthorizedByNameFormatted are generated using name components.
conditions: Records are retrieved only if a matching UserID exists.
Some fields (e.g., RoleID, Disabled) are only set if relevant data is present.
system_behavior: Retrieves user history details based on UserID.
Adds history records with full auditing fields.
Formats dates and names before returning results.
exceptions: If database query fails or no record found, an empty UserHistory is returned.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling logic described.
Some fields are commented out and may not be used.
The structure for roles added/removed and inactivation date is unclear.
